memoryPlan.basis: Current /proc/meminfo MemAvailable snapshot; services unchanged. Conservative extrapolation, not measured 1M RSS.
memoryPlan.projection: SDK-startup peak + 1.25 * (50k peak - SDK-startup peak) * (1000000 / smoke compacted tokens); scales worker startup too, deliberately conservative
memoryPlan.driverBasis: 1.5 times maximum observed smoke driver RSS
memoryPlan.reason: Five-way projection retains at least 1.5 GiB using current available-memory snapshot

methods.aggregates: median across three fresh processes; p50/p95 nearest-rank across 20 hot operations inside each process
methods.topN: intersection / number of base top-N ids, micro-weighted; empty base cases excluded and counted separately
methods.memory: same point as perf scaling: main GC after one context query; worker stats separately sampled without worker GC; no per-thread RSS exists
methods.stages: one separate timing-enabled 1M process per variant; phase start windows; mean per event, total per phase; inclusive nested spans, not additive
